name: ae-external-skills
description: Agent Everywhere's shareable skills. Install only the ones you need.

plugins.name: grokbot
plugins.description: CLI + skill: operate your Grok Bot desktop app from Claude Code on your Mac: agents, groups, sections, pins, transcripts, send --wait. Unofficial; needs Node 20+.

plugins.name: grokbot-box
plugins.description: Skill: for a Grok Bot agent inside its own cloud box: manage sibling Grok Bot workers (list, create, organize, send, delete) under an advisory agent policy. Unofficial.

plugins.name: desktop-cowork
plugins.description: Skill + helper: operate the Claude Desktop app on your Mac from Claude Code: tasks, replies, approvals, projects, skills, connectors. Unofficial; needs macOS 15+ and Peekaboo.

plugins.name: sales-navigator
plugins.description: 6 skills: LinkedIn Sales Navigator toolkit plus TAM accounts, TAM people, TAM tracker, outreach and DIY LinkedIn (no hosted API) skills. Runs in your own browser.

plugins.name: linkedin-find-people
plugins.description: One job: find decision-makers at a list of companies on your own LinkedIn Sales Navigator seat, with exact counts. Read-only. Runs in your own browser.

plugins.name: linkedin-find-companies
plugins.description: One job: find and qualify the companies that match your ideal customer on your own LinkedIn Sales Navigator seat. Read-only. Runs in your own browser.

plugins.name: linkedin-track-new-leads
plugins.description: One job: split a Sales Navigator search that is over the viewable cap, pull it in pieces and track what is covered. Runs in your own browser.

plugins.name: linkedin-outreach
plugins.description: One job: draft daily LinkedIn connection requests, InMails and follow-ups from your Sales Navigator seat; sends only after you approve the exact batch. Runs in your own browser.

plugins.name: linkedin-replies
plugins.description: One job: see who accepted and who replied on LinkedIn, from your own signed-in browser, with no hosted API; sends only after you approve the exact batch.

plugins.name: quickbooks
plugins.description: CLI + skill: operate QuickBooks Online through your own signed-in Chrome: lists, search, reports, and approval-gated creates/voids. Unofficial; needs Node 20+.

plugins.name: sourcewell
plugins.description: CLI + skill: read-only research of Sourcewell's public cooperative-purchasing data: who holds a contract and when it expires, open and upcoming bids, past awardees, participating agencies. Unofficial; needs Node 20+.

plugins.name: linkedin-emails
plugins.description: Skill + scripts: fill the missing emails in your LinkedIn connections CSV by reading each person's Contact info from your own logged-in LinkedIn browser, paced and read-only. No hosted service. Unofficial.
